title: Fairphone 6+ is now official and coming to the US
description: Fairphone has today announced its latest smartphone, the Fairphone 6+. It comes with 50% more RAM than the Fairphone 6 at 12GB vs. 8GB, and the newer Snapdragon 7s Gen 4 SoC. It's available in a new Cobalt Blue color, along with Forest Green and Horizon Black. These are the only changes from the Fairphone 6. Fairphone 6+ official images For the first time ever, a Fairphone device will be officially available in the US, from both Fairphone's online store and Amazon, with no caveats about it not running Android. You'll be able to pick one up for $649. In Europe, the price is...

title: Samsung Poland lists 7 SKUs for the Galaxy S26 FE
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is on a roll – yesterday, the phone appeared on the Google Play Console and in a hands-on video. Now, the FE model has been listed in an official Samsung document. The PDF in question comes from Samsung Poland and concerns the terms and conditions for Samsung Care+, the company’s extra insurance plan. The document doesn’t reveal much, but it does list 7 model numbers for the Galaxy S26 FE. An official Samsung Care+ PDF reveals seven model numbers for the Galaxy S26 FE So far, we’ve seen leaked renders that show three color options. Assuming there are two...

title: The Tecno Pova 8 Pro is now up on Flipkart, will launch in India later this week
description: Tecno unveiled the Pova 8 Pro last week, but the company kept launch details under wraps, saying only that it will debut in India on August 18 – that’s today! But no, the phone isn’t available yet. Sales in India will start on August 21 (Friday). Tecno has partnered with Flipkart to launch the phone and you can already visit the store pages and set up a notification to remind you on Friday. The 8/256GB model is priced ₹50,000 and the 12/512GB variant is ₹55,000. Note that there is a ₹3,000 instant cashback and no-cost EMI up to 18 months. The Tecno Pova 8 Pro comes in three...

title: Honor Pad 20 Pro announced with SD 8s Gen 4 and 10,100 mAh battery
description: The Honor Pad 20 made its debut back in May, and it is now getting a Pro counterpart with bumped-up specs. Honor Pad 20 Pro brings a more capable Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chipset alongside a 10,100mAh battery and a 12.1-inch IPS LCD. The panel offers 3K resolution (3,000 x 1,872px) with a 165Hz refresh rate and supports stylus input via the optional Honor Magic-Pencil 4s. Honor is also offering a Paperlike Edition of the Pad 20 Pro, which brings an anti-glare display for a more intuitive drawing and note-taking experience. Both versions of the Pad 20 Pro feature up to 700 nits peak...

title: Honor Robot Phone is now available in China
description: Following its announcement last week, Honor opened up the first round of open sales for the Robot Phone in China. The highly anticipated smartphone with a 200MP gimbal camera is now available from Honor’s official online store and partnering retailers with a starting price of CNY 9,999 for the 12/512GB trim. Based on today’s exchange rates, that amounts to about $1,483 or €1,281. Honor is also offering a 16GB RAM and 1TB storage version for CNY 12,999 ($1,928/€1,666). Honor confirmed the Robot Phone won't be available for purchase outside its homeland even though last week's...

title: iQOO reveals more details about the Indian Z11 and Buds TWS ahead of launch
description: iQOO will introduce the Z11 in India on August 20, with a design and specs different from the Chinese and Malaysian Z11. iQOO has already revealed a few features of the Indian Z11, and it has now shared more details about the smartphone. iQOO has revealed that the Indian Z11 will sport a 32MP selfie camera on the front, while the dual-camera setup on the rear will comprise a 50MP primary (Sony IMX882, OIS, 26mm) and an 8MP (15mm) ultrawide-angle camera. Additionally, iQOO announced that the Indian Z11 will get three years of Android OS upgrades and five years of security updates,...

title: Apple AirPods with cameras surface in leaked video
description: Apple has been rumored to be working on AirPods with built-in cameras for some time now. Despite a recent rumor claiming that the so-called AirPods Ultra project has been cancelled, a new video has surfaced showing the camera-equipped AirPods in action. The demo video for the camera-equipped AirPods was discovered by MacRumors in the latest macOS 26.7 release candidate. In the short clip, the wearer can be seen picking up a book and asking a question. A voiceover then says, “With Visual Intelligence, your world becomes savable. See something you like? title: Nothing's CMF teases a new pair of earbuds
description: Nothing's sub-brand CMF may not be launching a new smartphone this year, but it is still busy working on other products. And it now looks like the next one we're getting will be a new pair of earbuds. At least that's what the company's new teaser, seen below, strongly hints at. title: Google's Scam Detection feature is headed to another Android device maker
description: Google's Scam Detection can warn you of potential scams during phone calls, and so far it's been available for Pixels of course, but also Samsung flagships since the Galaxy S26 series. However, it turns out that the feature is probably headed to a third Android brand: vivo. According to a new report based on a teardown of the latest Phone by Google app, vivo phones should be next in line to support Scam Detection. In the screenshots below, note that "Sharpie" is an internal codename Google has for the Scam Detection feature. Google Scam Detection headed to vivo phones There's...

title: vivo V80 Lite 5G teaser image shows part of its front design
description: Earlier this month we heard that vivo was working on the V80 Lite 5G, and its listing on the Google Play Console revealed that it's most likely a rebranded vivo S2. Today on Instagram the image you can see below was posted by a multi-brand mobile store in Shajapur, India. It shows a little bit of the device's front design, though the image seems to be heavily embellished, so to speak. The screen is clearly curved, that's for sure, and there's a hole punch cutout for the selfie camera in the center. The V80 Lite 5G's slogan could be "slay every edge", as the image reveals. title: HMD 102 4G Pro specs leak
description: HMD launched the 102 4G back in September of last year and now the company seems to be working on an upgraded version called the 102 4G Pro. This has been leaked today by a usually reliable source of HMD-related information. According to said source, the new device will have a 2" QQVGA LCD screen, a 0.3MP camera, the Unisoc 8910FF-S chipset, 24MB of RAM, 48MB of internal storage, support for 32GB microSD cards, and a 1,200 mAh battery which charges via USB-C. The phone will be IP52 certified for dust and rain resistance, and it will have Bluetooth 4.2, a 3.5mm headphone jack, and...

title: Motorola Edge 70 Max in for review
description: This is the Motorola Edge 70 Max, which launched last month. Let's take a look inside it box and see what it's about. The Edge 70 Max ships with 256GB of storage and either 8GB or 12GB of RAM. You can get it in Pantone Aqua Gray, Pantone Ice Melt, and Pantone Dark Shadow (our model), each with a unique-feeling texture. Prices are €750, £700, or INR 59,999. Unboxing the Motorola Edge 70 Max You get the usual cable and case in the box. The case isn't MagSafe-compatible, which is a shame, as we've seen lower-tier Motos with a MagSafe case in the box. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE stars in a hands-on video
description: The Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is coming soon, having been already certified by the FCC and starred in multiple leaks recently. It may be unveiled in early September alongside the new Galaxy Tab S12 tablets. Ahead of that, a user on X has uploaded what he claims is a hands-on video of the Galaxy S26 FE. title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max with 10,000mAh battery to launch next week
description: Xiaomi has officially announced the launch of the new Redmi Note 17 Pro Max in global markets and also revealed some of its key specs. One of the phone's biggest highlights is its 10,000mAh battery. The company has set up a teaser page on its global website, confirming that the Redmi Note 17 series, including the new Note 17 Pro Max, will be unveiled on August 27. According to the official page, the handset will pack a 10,000mAh battery with 100W wired fast charging support. title: Xiaomi Redmi Watch 6 Lite and Redmi Watch 6 Active leak again with specs and pricing
description: The Xiaomi Redmi Watch 6 Active and the Redmi Watch 6 Lite have leaked yet again – this time they broke cover as they surfaced on a price tracking site in Hungary. The Redmi Watch 6 Lite has a rectangular 1.96” OLED display (410 x 502px) and a 470mAh battery that should last up to 18 days. The watch measures 39.4 x 44.5 x 9.9mm without the strap. The previous model, the Redmi Watch 5 Lite, measured 11.4mm thick and had the same battery capacity. The body is rated for 5 ATM of water resistance and uses a proprietary charging connector. title: Samsung Galaxy S26 FE, A08 and A07s surface on the Google Play Console
description: After clearing the FCC, the Samsung Galaxy S26 FE is now past another major hurdle – it is now listed on the Google Play Console. Two entry-level models joined it, the Galaxy A08 and A07s. The Galaxy S26 FE specs leaked in detail last week. The console confirms the chipset as S5E9955, aka the Exynos 2500. The phone (SM-S741U) is configured with 8GB of RAM and a 1,080 x 2,340px display as expected. title: Samsung partners up with Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, here's what that means
description: Today, Samsung has announced that it is the official partner of the upcoming Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4. The game is due to be released on October 23. Samsung is "the official TV, monitor, soundbar, and Wi-Fi speaker partner" of the game. In practice, this means that the game will support Samsung's HDR10+ Gaming format, which "helps deliver more accurate color and contrast, supporting the immersive visual experience that reflects the creative intent of the developers", according to the company. Additionally, the game will support the 32:9 aspect ratio of Samsung's Odyssey G9...

title: Huawei schedules launch event for September 2
description: Huawei will be holding its next product launch event on September 2 in Munich, Germany. The keynote features the “Chase the wild” tagline, and we’re expecting to see the latest crop of wearables from the brand. Huawei recently unveiled the Watch GT 7 series in China so it seems like the perfect time to bring the Watch GT 7 and GT 7 Pro to the global stage. Huawei has historically also introduced new wireless earbuds alongside its smartwatches, so we’ll have to wait and see if that will be the case this time.
